general.title: General Configuration
general.description: Basic system configuration and maintenance settings

maintenanceMode.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenanceMode.description: When enabled, the system will be in maintenance mode and users will not be able to access certain features
maintenanceMode.help: Use maintenance mode to perform system updates or maintenance tasks

regions.label: Innovation Sandbox Managed Regions
regions.description: AWS regions managed by the Innovation Sandbox solution
regions.help: These are the regions where sandbox accounts can be created and managed

termsOfService.label: Terms of Service
termsOfService.description: Terms of service that users must accept
termsOfService.help: Legal terms and conditions for using the Innovation Sandbox

appConfig.info: To change these settings, please go to
appConfig.description: Settings are managed through AWS AppConfig for centralized configuration management

lease.title: Lease Configuration
lease.description: Settings for lease management and user limits

maxBudget.label: Max Budget
maxBudget.description: Maximum budget allowed for a single lease
maxBudget.help: This is the upper limit for lease budgets that users can request

requireMaxBudget.label: Require Max Budget
requireMaxBudget.description: Whether users must specify a maximum budget for their lease
requireMaxBudget.help: When enabled, users cannot create leases without specifying a budget limit

maxDuration.label: Max Lease Duration
maxDuration.description: Maximum duration allowed for a single lease
maxDuration.help: This is the upper limit for lease duration that users can request

requireMaxDuration.label: Require Max Lease Duration
requireMaxDuration.description: Whether users must specify a maximum duration for their lease
requireMaxDuration.help: When enabled, users cannot create leases without specifying a duration limit

maxLeasesPerUser.label: Max leases per user
maxLeasesPerUser.description: Maximum number of active leases a single user can have
maxLeasesPerUser.help: This prevents users from creating too many concurrent leases

cleanup.title: Cleanup Configuration
cleanup.description: Settings for account cleanup processes and retry logic

waitBeforeRerun.label: Wait before Rerun Successful Attempt
waitBeforeRerun.description: Time to wait before rerunning a successful cleanup attempt
waitBeforeRerun.help: This prevents cleanup processes from running too frequently

failedAttempts.label: Number of failed attempts to cancel cleanup
failedAttempts.description: How many failed attempts before canceling the cleanup process
failedAttempts.help: This prevents infinite retry loops for failed cleanup operations

waitBeforeRetry.label: Wait before retrying failed attempt
waitBeforeRetry.description: Time to wait before retrying a failed cleanup attempt
waitBeforeRetry.help: This gives temporary issues time to resolve before retrying

successfulAttempts.label: Number of successful attempts to finish cleanup
successfulAttempts.description: How many successful attempts needed to consider cleanup complete
successfulAttempts.help: This ensures cleanup is thoroughly completed before marking as done

ssoEnabled.label: Single Sign-On (SSO) Enabled
ssoEnabled.help: SSO provides centralized authentication through your organization's identity provider

mfaRequired.label: Multi-Factor Authentication Required
mfaRequired.description: Whether MFA is required for all users
mfaRequired.help: MFA adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second form of authentication

sessionTimeout.label: Session Timeout
sessionTimeout.description: How long user sessions remain active without activity
sessionTimeout.help: Shorter timeouts improve security but may impact user experience

maxConcurrentSessions.label: Max Concurrent Sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions per user
maxConcurrentSessions.help: Limiting concurrent sessions helps prevent account sharing

notifications.title: Notification Configuration
notifications.description: Settings for system notifications and alerts

enabled.label: Email Notifications Enabled
enabled.description: Whether email notifications are sent to users
enabled.help: Email notifications keep users informed about important events

fromAddress.label: From Email Address
fromAddress.description: Email address used as sender for notifications
fromAddress.help: This should be a monitored email address from your organization

budgetThreshold.label: Budget Alert Threshold
budgetThreshold.description: Percentage of budget used before sending alerts
budgetThreshold.help: Alerts help users manage their spending before reaching limits

expirationWarning.label: Lease Expiration Warning
expirationWarning.description: How many hours before expiration to send warning
expirationWarning.help: Warnings give users time to extend or save work before expiration

advanced.title: Advanced Configuration
advanced.description: Advanced system settings and debugging options

level.label: Log Level
level.description: Minimum level of logs to record
level.help: Higher levels provide more detail but may impact performance

retention.label: Log Retention Period
retention.description: How long to keep log files
retention.help: Longer retention helps with troubleshooting but uses more storage

cacheTimeout.label: Cache Timeout
cacheTimeout.description: How long to cache frequently accessed data
cacheTimeout.help: Longer cache times improve performance but may show stale data

maxConcurrentOperations.label: Max Concurrent Operations
maxConcurrentOperations.description: Maximum number of operations that can run simultaneously
maxConcurrentOperations.help: Higher limits improve throughput but may impact system stability

validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
validation.conflictingSettings: This setting conflicts with another configuration

messages.confirmImport: Are you sure you want to import this configuration? This will overwrite current settings.

help.general: General settings control basic system behavior and maintenance options
help.lease: Lease settings define limits and requirements for user lease requests
help.cleanup: Cleanup settings control how accounts are cleaned and recycled
help.security: Security settings manage authentication and access controls
help.notifications: Notification settings control how users are informed of system events
help.advanced: Advanced settings are for system administrators and debugging

userPreferences.title: User Preferences
userPreferences.description: Customize your experience with Innovation Sandbox. Changes are saved automatically and will persist across sessions.

language.label: Interface Language
language.description: Select your preferred language for the user interface. This setting will be remembered for future sessions.
